mapper.select: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.score DESC) AS rankPosition, l.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.display_name AS displayName, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, l.score AS score, l.created_at AS createdAt FROM leaderboards l INNER JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id WHERE l.game_id = #{gameId} AND l.type = #{type} ORDER BY l.score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ranked.rankPosition AS rankPosition, ranked.score AS score, ranked.createdAt AS createdAt FROM ( SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.score DESC) AS rankPosition, l.score AS score, l.created_at AS createdAt, l.user_id AS uid FROM leaderboards l WHERE l.game_id = #{gameId} AND l.type = #{type} ) ranked WHERE ranked.uid = #{userId}

SELECT ranked.gameId AS gameId, ranked.gameName AS gameName, ranked.thumbnailUrl AS thumbnailUrl, ranked.rankPosition AS rankPosition, ranked.score AS score, ranked.createdAt AS createdAt FROM ( SELECT l.game_id AS gameId, g.name AS gameName, g.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.game_id ORDER BY l.score DESC) AS rankPosition, l.user_id AS uid, l.score AS score, l.created_at AS createdAt FROM leaderboards l INNER JOIN games g ON l.game_id = g.id WHERE l.type = 'all_time' ) ranked WHERE ranked.uid = #{userId} ORDER BY ranked.rankPosition ASC
